findings.description: There are only 22 screens, but the reference expects 23 (title card plus 22 sentences). Sentence 21 ("The foods you eat, your response to challenges, the amount of exercise you get, and many other factors appear to influence your telomeres and can prevent premature aging at the cellular level.", 13 vocab entries) has no screen. Screen 21 is SENTENCE 20/22 and screen 22 jumps to SENTENCE 22/22 (its progress bar is full). The progress bars confirm it: screens 2–21 measure 1–20/22 and screen 22 measures 22/22.

The Chinese translation is drawn at an abnormally huge size, about 5x the normal translation size, with only 7 characters per line. It runs over the footer: "可信任。" covers "SENTENCE 12 / 22" and the progress bar, and is cut off at the bottom edge of the frame. The grey bar also runs off the bottom. The text block is pushed upward, so the first English line ("Cynical① hostility② is defined by③ high") sits on the header, on top of "CET-6 READING" and the header rule. Circle 1 is drawn over the header text and "high" runs into the header's right-hand text.

The English has circles 2,1... in this order: 1 (Even though), 2 (born with), 4 (particular), 3 (a … set of), 5, 6, 7. The vocabulary panel lists only 1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7. Entry 2 "be born with 生来就有" is missing from the panel, which leaves a gap in the panel numbering. The highlighted "born with②" has no panel entry.
The Chinese translation contains two replacement characters (�): "它们在染色体末端形成帽状结构，��把遗传物质维系在一起。" The reference reads "…帽状结构，把遗传物质维系在一起。" The two black diamond question marks should not be there.

The footer reads "SENTENCE 8 / 22", but this screen is sentence 9 ("This isn't the only reason a cell can age—…"). The previous screen (screen 9) is already SENTENCE 8 / 22. The progress bar on this screen is filled to 9/22, so the label and the bar disagree.

"civil servants" and its circle ② are drawn in dark green, the single-word colour. Panel entry 2 "civil servant 公务员" is a phrase (短语) and is drawn in rust, and every other phrase on the screen is rust. The highlight and circle should be rust.

Panel entry 1 "key to ……的关键" draws the Chinese ellipsis as six low baseline dots ("......的关键", Western periods). Every other entry in the video draws it as a centred Chinese ellipsis, e.g. "对……的压力" on screen 10 and "在……的末端" on screens 6 and 7.

Bad line break in the English: the em dash after "age②" wraps to the next line, so line 2 starts with a dash ("—there are other stresses on③ …") instead of the dash staying at the end of line 1 with "age".

Sentence 21 has no screen. The video has 22 screens, but the reference expects 23 (title card plus 22 sentences). The screens go from sentence 20 (screen21, 'Your telomeres are listening to you.') straight to sentence 22 (screen22, 'SENTENCE 22 / 22'). 'The foods you eat, your response to challenges, the amount of exercise you get, and many other factors appear to influence your telomeres and can prevent premature aging at the cellular level.' never appears, and neither do its 13 vocabulary entries.

A word is missing from the English. The screen reads 'To an extent, it has surprised and the rest of the scientific community…'. The reference reads 'To an extent, it has surprised us and the rest of the scientific community…'. 'us' is missing after 'surprised'. The rest of the sentence matches.

A vocabulary entry is missing. In the English, 'born with' is highlighted as a phrase with circle 2, but the panel goes 1 even though, 3 a set of, 4 particular, 5 gene, 6 influence, 7 express oneself. Entry 2, 'be born with' (短语, 生来就有), is not shown. The other entries and highlights match the reference ('a … set of' is correctly split, with its number on 'set of').

The layout is broken. The Chinese translation is drawn far too large (about 4 lines of very big characters). This pushes the English up into the header: 'Cynical' sits on top of 'CET-6 READING' and the header rule, and both are unreadable. 'high' runs into the paper/title header text. The last Chinese line '可信任。' covers the footer 'SENTENCE 12 / 22' and the progress bar, and is cut off at the bottom of the screen. The English words themselves match the reference, and so do the vocabulary panel entries 1–7.

The footer has the wrong sentence number. The screen shows sentence 9 ('This isn't the only reason a cell can age—…grow old.'), and its progress bar sits between screens 9 and 11, but the footer reads 'SENTENCE 8 / 22'. That repeats screen09's number; it should be 'SENTENCE 9 / 22'.

The phrase 'civil servants' is shown in the dark-green single-word colour, and its circle 2 is green too. It is a phrase (短语): panel entry 2 'civil servant' is rust, with a rust circle. Its highlight should be rust/brown like 'scored high on' and 'cynical hostility' on the same screen.
The meaning for entry 1 'key to' is shown as '......的关键', with six ASCII periods, instead of the reference '……的关键', which uses the Chinese ellipsis. Every other entry uses '……' correctly.

Bad line break at the em dash. The dash that belongs right after 'age' (circle 2) wraps to the start of line 2, so the line begins '—there are other…'. The dash ends up on the next line, separated from 'age'. The text is correct, but the break looks wrong; on screen19 the dash in 'slowed—and' stays attached.

The Chinese translation contains two replacement glyphs (U+FFFD, a black diamond with a question mark) between the comma and 把. The screen reads '它们在染色体末端形成帽状结构，��把遗传物质维系在一起。'. The reference is '它们在染色体末端形成帽状结构，把遗传物质维系在一起。'. The two garbage characters must be removed.

The VOCABULARY panel is missing entry 2. It lists ① even though 尽管；即使, ③ a set of 一套；一组, ④ particular 特定的, ⑤ gene 基因, ⑥ influence 影响, ⑦ express oneself （基因）表达；显现出来. The entry 'be born with 生来就有' does not appear, although 'born with' is highlighted in the English with circle ②.

The footer reads 'SENTENCE 8 / 22', but the screen shows sentence 9 ('This isn't the only reason a cell can age—...'). It should read 'SENTENCE 9 / 22'. The previous screen (screen09, sentence 8) also reads 8 / 22. The Chinese text and vocabulary on this screen match the reference.

'civil servants' is a phrase (短语), but it is highlighted in dark green (the single-word colour) with a green ② circle; measured colour is about (16,80,64), the same as 'study'. In the VOCABULARY panel, entry ② 'civil servant 公务员' is correctly rust-coloured. The English highlight should be rust/brown.

Vocabulary entry ① 'key to' shows its meaning as '......的关键': six heavy dots on the baseline (Latin-style). The reference is '……的关键' with the Chinese ellipsis, whose dots are vertically centred, as in other entries such as '在……上得分高' and '在……深处'. The punctuation does not match the reference visually.

- **Title card and headers:** they match the reference: 端粒在“倾听”：生活方式与衰老, 大学英语六级 2022年12月 第3套 · Passage One. The header on screen13 is unreadable because the sentence text overlaps it.

- **Vocabulary panels:** every headword and POS matches the reference, and so does each entry's highlighted text. The exceptions are the missing 'be born with' on screen04 and the missing sentence 21 screen.
- **Numbering:** the panels number entries by first appearance in the sentence, which is sometimes a different order from the reference list (s3: 'a … set of' gets 3 before 'particular' 4; s5: 'or' gets 6). That follows the stated design, so I did not report it.
- **Headword colour, not reported:** on every screen the single-word headwords in the panel are drawn in near-black ink (about RGB 24,32,32), not the dark-green highlight colour (about 24,88,72); phrase headwords are correctly rust. The design brief says entries use the same colour as their highlight, so whoever owns highlight colours may want to confirm whether this is intended.

I opened all 22 screens and the reference file. Each Chinese translation and each vocabulary-panel meaning was enlarged and transcribed character by character. Characters prone to look-alike errors were checked by ASCII-rendering their pixel bitmaps: 未 in 未老先衰 (screen 2, both instances), 末 in 末端 (screens 6 and 7, both instances), 已 in 已经 (screens 11 and 12), 入 in 投入 (screen 11), 己 in 自己 (screen 22, both instances) and 全 in 完全 (screen 9). The ？ at the end of sentence 1 renders as the CJK font's glyph, and the source text uses the fullwidth ？, so I did not report it.

The source annotation /home/user/university-entrance-examination/六级/ann/s44.txt has the correct text for sentence 6, the 'be born with' entry and 'civil servant', so these defects come from rendering, not from the data. /home/user/university-entrance-examination/六级/tools/make_video.py already has a lang="zh-CN" fix for the '……的关键' ellipsis rendering; this video apparently predates that fix or bypassed it.

findings.description: The second half of sentence 24 is missing the words "within their team". The screen reads "… but also build a safety climate that supports intervening and open communication among them." The reference has "… build a safety climate within their team that supports intervening …". Because those words are missing, the panel shows entries 14 "within prep. 在……内部" and 15 "team n. 团队", but the English has no highlighted item and no circle 14 or 15. The circles in the English run 7, 12, 13, 16, 17, 18, 19, 20 while the panel shows 7, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18, 19, 20.

Sentence 16 shows the wrong Chinese translation. It shows "恐惧是人们不出面干预的根本因素。", which is sentence 17's translation and appears again on screen 18. It should show "尽管工人们受到鼓励，看到不安全的操作时要出面干预，但真正这样做的情况还不到一半。". The English, footer (16 / 25) and panel (1–7) on this screen are correct.

The title card reads "大学英语六级 2024年6月 第2套 · Passage Two". The reference and the header on every sentence screen say Passage One ("2024年6月 第2套 · Passage One"). The title and the genre (说明文 · 职场与安全) are correct.

Vocabulary entry 1 "part of ……的一部分" draws the Chinese ellipsis as six low baseline dots ("......的一部分", Latin style). Every other ellipsis in the video is drawn with centred dots, for example 越……就越 on screens 10 and 12, 担心……；害怕…… on screen 19, 阻止……（做） on screen 23 and 发挥……作用 on screen 24. Here it is the first character of the meaning and seems to fall back to the Latin font.

The panel on the second half of the split starts with 7 ("not only...but also", repeated from screen 25), then jumps to 12. The sequence 7, 12, 13, … is a repeat and a gap, not a straight continuation from 11. On screen 25 the first piece "not only" carries circle 7 even though it is not the last piece of the phrase. This is probably a deliberate choice for a phrase that spans the split; it is noted so the convention can be confirmed.

Part 2 of sentence 24 drops the words "within their team". The screen reads "… but also build a safety climate that supports intervening and open communication among them." The reference has "…build a safety climate within their team that supports intervening…". The vocabulary panel still lists 14 within (prep.) and 15 team (n.), but neither word appears in the English, so there are no ⑭ or ⑮ highlights and the numbering in the text jumps from 13 to 16.

The Chinese line on sentence 16 is the translation of sentence 17 ("恐惧是人们不出面干预的根本因素。", which also appears on screen 18). It should be the reference ZH for sentence 16: "尽管工人们受到鼓励，看到不安全的操作时要出面干预，但真正这样做的情况还不到一半。" The English and vocabulary on this screen are correct.
The title card subtitle reads "大学英语六级 2024年6月 第2套 · Passage Two". The reference (q2: 大学英语六级 2024年6月 第2套 Passage One) and every sentence-screen header say "Passage One".

The gloss for vocabulary entry 1 "part of" shows "......的一部分" with dots on the baseline, as if in the Latin font. Every other gloss in this video (e.g. 对……的恐惧, 越……就越) shows the vertically centred Chinese ellipsis "……". The reference has "……的一部分".

The Chinese translation on this screen belongs to the next sentence. It reads '恐惧是人们不出面干预的根本因素。', which is sentence 17's ZH and appears again on screen 18. Sentence 16 should read '尽管工人们受到鼓励，看到不安全的操作时要出面干预，但真正这样做的情况还不到一半。' The English and vocabulary on the screen are correct for sentence 16.

Look-alike character substitution in the Chinese translation: '不实施安全干预' is shown as '不实施安仝干预'. The glyph is 人 over 工 with two horizontal strokes (仝), not 人 over 王 with three (全). At 4-6x zoom it differs clearly from the 全 on the title card ('职场与安全') and from 'safety n. 安全' in the same screen's vocabulary panel. Should read '但在工作场所，不实施安全干预的并非只有一线工人。'

In part 2 of the split sentence, the English leaves out 'within their team'. It shows '… but also build a safety climate that supports intervening…'; the reference is '… but also build a safety climate within their team that supports intervening…'. The vocabulary panel still lists 14 within (prep. 在……内部) and 15 team (n. 团队), but neither word appears or is highlighted in the sentence: the numbering jumps from 13 to 16.
The title card subtitle reads '大学英语六级 2024年6月 第2套 · Passage Two', but the reference and the header on every sentence screen (2-27) say 'Passage One'.
In the vocabulary panel, 'growing adj. 日益严重的；不断增长的' carries circle 4 instead of 3. The panel therefore reads 1, 2, 4, 4 ('off the job' is also 4), while the English text marks growing with 3.

The vocabulary meaning for 'part of' shows six baseline Latin dots ('......的一部分') instead of the centred Chinese ellipsis '……的一部分' given in the reference. Every other gloss on these screens renders 省略号 centred (e.g. '对……的恐惧', '发挥……作用'). The source text holds U+2026 twice, so this is a rendering defect when a gloss starts with the ellipsis right after the English headword.
